title: Fresh Snow vs Planned Ski Days
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
(index=personal sourcetype=onthesnow:report fresh_snow_cm=*) OR (index=personal sourcetype=slopes:session)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats max(fresh_snow_cm) as fresh_snow, count(eval(sourcetype="slopes:session")) as ski_sessions by _time resort_name
| where fresh_snow>=10
| sort - fresh_snow
description: Highlights days with ten or more centimetres of fresh snow and whether a Slopes session was logged.
value: Powder days are the payoff for season-pass math; this view shows whether you actually got out for them.
implementation: Combine OnTheSnow daily reports with Slopes session counts by resort and date.
visualization: Timeline of fresh-snow days with ski-session markers.
grandmaExplanation: It watches which big snow days you skied versus the ones you missed.
